help.text:
gitlab-upgrade — safe upgrades for self-managed GitLab Omnibus

  gitlab-upgrade [command] [options]

Commands
  (no arguments)     check + plan + confirmation
  check              is there anything to upgrade; exit codes 0/10/20/30 for cron
  plan               detection, checks and the plan; changes nothing
  doctor             checks only
  config             settings screen
  version            tool version
  help               this help

Target
  --from <ver>            force the current version
  --to <ver>              final version
  --target-major <n>      upper major bound
  --safe-for-os           do not go above the current OS ceiling
  --patch-only            only a patch within the current minor

Network
  --proxy <url>           http://… or socks5://…
  --proxy-ca <path>       corporate proxy CA for TLS interception
  --proxy-all-apt         proxy every repository, not just gitlab

Output
  --lang ru|en            interface language (defaults to the locale, else en)
  --plain                 line output without ANSI
  --json                  event stream, one object per line
  --no-color              (NO_COLOR is honoured too)
  --explain-config        show where each value came from

check exit codes: 0 current · 10 patch · 20 minor · 30 major · 1 error
